_about: Cases where the C# port deliberately answers differently from the Python oracle. Every entry says why. A difference that is not listed here is drift, and fails the parity run.

session_files.validate.duration_bool: Python treats a bool as an int, so "duration_sec": true passes as one second. The port refuses it - a session that says true there is wrong, and saying so beats playing a one-second session.
session_files.validate.freq_bool: Same quirk: "freq": true would play at one beat per second. The port refuses it.
